items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I took the little Chinese girl off alto and put her on baritone

ctx.x: Well, the war was on in Europe, but America wasn't in it.

I don't think so, no. I don't remember. But anyway, a number of the fellows came down and heard the band in rehearsal. Willard Wright came down and helped the band in a dance, and they came out to the house where I was rehearsing these girls. I took the little Chinese girl off alto and put her on baritone, and I got girls and I wrote two numbers and I rehearsed them like 10:00 in the morning till 10:00 at night. And then we'd give a dance, a trial. And I said, they're ready for the Apollo.
And sure enough, we played that dance and Willy Bryant came down there to M.C. the show (inaudible). Said,
